Tests that extraction_timeout_secs config field is accepted and does not affect fast extractions

```swift title="Swift"
import Xberg

let result = try await Xberg.extract("{\"kind\":\"uri\",\"uri\":\"https://example.com/pdf/fake_memo.pdf\"}", "{\"extraction_timeout_secs\":300}")
debugPrint(result.results()[0].mimeType())
debugPrint(result.results()[0].content())
```
